definition.title: Map coding-agent discovery paths
definition.description: For founders selling to people who live in Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex: reverse-engineer when a buyer would notice you inside an agent session, rank realistic presence surfaces, draft useful (not spammy) assets, and hand off to existing Tin workflows.

product_url.title: Public product URL
product_url.description: Public HTTPS marketing or product page used to ground positioning.

buyer_persona.title: Who buys, and how they work
buyer_persona.description: Describe the person (role, tools, day). Example: solo founder who prototypes in Cursor and only notices tools their agent can already use.

product_one_liner.title: Optional one-liner
product_one_liner.description: Leave empty to derive from the site and project files.

focus_surfaces.title: Surface focus
focus_surfaces.description: Narrow the inventory, or keep all for a first pass.

known_competitors.title: Optional competitor names or URLs
known_competitors.description: One per line. Used only to check whether they already show up in agent-native channels.

constraints.title: Constraints
constraints.description: Brand voice, markets to skip, or hard bans (no cold DMs, no drive-by issues, etc.).
